Description: (v7.5) AWS CFT to deploy a FortiAnalyzer A-P single AZ HA cluster into an existing VPC

VPCCIDR.Description: Provide a network CIDR for the VPC
VPCCIDR.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid CIDR block format.

SubnetAZ1.Description: Select the subnet in AZ1 to the FortiAnalyzers into

SubnetAZ2.Description: Select the subnet in AZ3 to deploy the FortiAnalyzer into

FortiAnalyzer1IPMgmt.Description: Provide the IP address in CIDR form for FortiAnalyzer1 to use for Mgmt
FortiAnalyzer1IPMgmt.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid CIDR block format.

FortiAnalyzer1IPCluster.Description: Provide the IP address in CIDR form for FortiAnalyzer1 to use for Cluster Failover
FortiAnalyzer1IPCluster.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid CIDR block format.

FortiAnalyzer2IPMgmt.Description: Provide the IP address in CIDR form for FortiAnalyzer2 to use for Mgmt
FortiAnalyzer2IPMgmt.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid CIDR block format.

FortiAnalyzer2IPCluster.Description: Provide the IP address in CIDR form for FortiAnalyzer2 to use for Cluster Failover
FortiAnalyzer2IPCluster.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid CIDR block format.

HaPassword.Description: Provide a password for encrypting HA communication between the FortiAnalyzers

FortiAnalyzer1SN.Description: [BYOL Only, leave blank for PAYG] Provide the license Serial Number for FortiAnalyzer1

FortiAnalyzer2SN.Description: [BYOL Only, leave blank for PAYG] Provide the license Serial Number for FortiAnalyzer2

PubliclyAvailable.Description: Select 'Yes' if the FAZs will have an EIP to be publicly available or not.  *** If you select 'No', then an S3 endpoint needs to be deployed and reachable from the subnet the FortiAnalyzers are in to successfully bootstrap.  Also, the FortiAnalyzers require internet access to communicate with FortiCare successfully for license validation. ***

InstanceType.Description: Select the instance type for the FortiAnalyzers.  *** If using PAYG2Devices for LicenseType, you can only use up to a m5.xlarge ***

CIDRForInstanceAccess.Description: Provide a network CIDR from which the FortiAnalyzer instances will be accessed

KeyPair.Description: Select a keypair to associate with the FortiAnalyzers

EncryptVolumes.Description: Select 'true' to encrypt the FortiAnalyzer instances OS and Log volumes with your account's KMS default master key for EBS.  Otherwise select false to leave unencrypted

S3EndpointDeployment.Description: Select if a new S3 Endpoint should be deployed or not. If you used the BaseVPC template then select UseExisting.  *** If the FortiAnalyzers does not have direct internet access, an S3 Endpoint should be used and associated to the subnet the FortiAnalyzers will be deployed in for successful bootstrapping ***

SubnetRouteTableID.Description: If a new S3 Endpoint is to be deployed, provide the route table ID associated with the subnet the FortiAnalyzers will be deployed in.

InitS3Bucket.Description: Provide the Init S3 Bucket name, where your config files will be created  *** the bucket should exist in the same region as this deployment for successful bootstrapping ***

FortiAnalyzerVersion.Description: Select the verion of FortiAnalyzer to use (latest GA AMI will be used)

LicenseType.Description: Select the license type for the FortiAnalyzers

FortiAnalyzer1LicenseFile.Description: [BYOL Only, leave blank for PAYG] Provide the name of the BYOL license file in the Init S3 Bucket for FortiAnalyzer1 (ie faz1.lic or prefix/faz1.lic)

FortiAnalyzer2LicenseFile.Description: [BYOL Only, leave blank for PAYG] Provide the name of the BYOL license file in the Init S3 Bucket for FortiAnalyzer2 (ie faz1.lic or prefix/faz1.lic)

SecurityGroupIngress.Description: Allow local VPC access to Faz
Allow 10.0.0.0/8 access to tcp port 514 Faz
Allow 172.16.0.0/12 access to tcp port 514 Faz
Allow 192.168.0.0/16 access to tcp port 514 Faz
Allow 10.0.0.0/8 access to udp port 514 Faz
Allow 172.16.0.0/12 access to udp port 514 Faz
Allow 192.168.0.0/16 access to udp port 514 Faz

Properties.Description: Allow FAZs to access each other
